_comment: Generated by scripts/conformance_scoreboard.py — per-policy conformance drill-down for one jurisdiction. Do not hand-edit.

policies.note: Initialises input variables consumed by later policies (writes bsa_s/bls_s/etc. as inputs), not a computed instrument.
Labour-market-transition module, switched off; the XML comment says 'DO NOT SWITCH ON; ONLY WORKS WITH THE [transition data]'. Carries transition inputs, not a distinct benefit/tax.

BEN: the prior cross-region child-benefit comparison targeted a generated annual aggregate that is not stated in a public-policy document. Documentary regional amount and entitlement rules remain encoded, but this policy has no current conformance binding until an external composition and fresh direct target can be supplied without adding Axiom policy logic.

BEN: the prior cross-region birth-allowance comparison targeted a generated routing aggregate that is not stated in a public-policy document. Documentary regional allowance rules remain encoded, but this policy has no current conformance binding until an external selector and fresh direct target are available.

BEN: study allowances (Flemish + French Community, 147 functions). The former region-routing suite was retired because the cross-Community selector and EUROMOD take-up controls are comparison orchestration, not concepts stated in public-policy documents. Source-backed Community allowance modules remain encoded; a future bed_s comparison must select them externally.

BEN: parental-leave allowance (RVA/ONEM career-break), encoded in rulespec-be#86 (RD 29.10.1997 durations + RD 02.01.1991 amounts). EUROMOD bfapl_be simulates it and writes bfapl_s, but the lpb parental-leave-months input column is absent from the BE HHoT demo dataset schema, so bfapl_s stays 0 for every synthetic case under the registration-free setup — the only achievable comparison is vacuous (0 == 0). Probe evidence: exhaustive leave-lane input sweep in axiom-oracles#150/#158, lpb absence recorded in docs/be-coverage-matrix.md; lineage rulespec-be#86 / axiom-oracles#160.
BEN: maternity-leave indemnity. The be-maternity-leave suite live-compares bmact_s and matches EUROMOD exactly (3/3); the published dashboard report exists, so the policy is now covered.
BEN: paternity/birth-leave compensation. The be-birth-leave suite live-compares bpact_s and matches EUROMOD exactly (3/3); the published dashboard report exists, so the policy is now covered.

Elderly income guarantee (GRAPA/IGO). Marked 'TO BE SWITCHED ON MANUALLY, otherwise from data' in BE_2025, so it is off in a default run, but activatable per run via euromod_policy_switch_overrides [(bsaoa_be, True)] (the bun_be precedent — the adapter patches the model XML; no extension switch enables it). The be-elderly-income-support suite switches bsaoa_be on and live-compares bsaoa_s (garantie de revenus aux personnes agees) against the composed RuleSpec payable amount, matching EUROMOD exactly (1/1). Now covered; the prior not_a_policy exclusion is superseded by the published activated suite.

Unemployment benefit marked 'PART SIMULATED' and switched OFF in BE_2025. The former composed bun_s pilot was retired because it exported a comparator-shaped payable output. Documentary Royal Decree modules remain encoded; a future comparison must compose them externally.

Early-retirement benefit (12 functions, 106 params) carrying policy switch n/a in BE_2025, not off. A live probe forcing byr_be on via the model-XML switch overlay (same mechanism as GRAPA bsaoa_be) returns no byr_s column while the run succeeds, so n/a is structural — the functions never register in the spine and no override resurrects them. poa (old-age pension) has no computing policy at all; both flow as pure input into ils_ben and disposable income. The rulespec-be worker-pension encoding (retirement_and_survivor.yaml; RD No. 50, RD 23.12.1996) validates via other oracles, not EUROMOD.

Indirect consumption tax (VAT/excise). In BE_2025 its body is 15 DefConst/DefIl functions with no OutputVar and no compute function, and the public EUROMOD_RELEASES_J2.0+ ships no consumption-tax extension (no CT_X* add-on computes VAT/excise) and no COICOP expenditure microdata. So the oracle cannot simulate a comparable amount; the policy would be a real tax only with the absent extension. Verdict recorded in euromod_be_coverage.json (tco_be.conformance), axiom-oracles#144.

TAX: PIT fiscal expenditures. The former end-to-end worker-PIT credit suite was retired with its comparator-shaped pipeline. Article 289ter/1 and the other source-backed reduction rules remain documentary modules; any comparison to tintcly_s must target those legal outputs directly and perform surrounding PIT composition outside atomic RuleSpec.
TAX: separately-taxed movable/capital income tax. The be-capital-income-tax suite live-compares tinkt_s (movable_withholding) and matches EUROMOD exactly (3/3).
TAX: municipal PIT surcharge (communal centimes). The be-local-municipal-pit suite live-compares tinmu_s (communal_additions) and matches EUROMOD exactly (3/3).

TAX: federal PIT. The former single-worker end-to-end oracle pipeline was retired because its composed output was not itself a concept stated in a public-policy document. Documentary PIT stages remain encoded for external composition.

TAX: regional PIT additional tax. The be-regional-pit-surcharge suite live-compares tinrg_s (special financing law of 16 January 1989 article 5/2 — the reduced State tax times the region's additional-tax percentage, 32.591% Brussels / 33.257% Flanders and Wallonia) and matches EUROMOD exactly (3/3, one case per region).

TAX: PIT professional-expense forfait. The active be-article-51-forfait suite now bridges EUROMOD il_netYem directly into the legacy documentary article_51_forfaits module and no longer imports the retired worker oracle pipeline. Its previous dashboard report is retained only as historical evidence because it targeted that deleted pipeline. Coverage remains open until the signed canonical page-121/page-122 migration lands and this suite is rerun against its receipted target.

TAX: PIT deductions & marital quotient. The former couple oracle pipeline was retired because its household composition and technical role selectors were not concepts stated in public-policy documents. Documentary Article 87–89 and joint-assessment rules remain encoded for external composition.

TAX: the prior current comparison targeted a gross-withholding aggregate with supplied local centimes that is not a documentary RuleSpec output. Documentary cadastral-indexation and regional property-tax components remain encoded, but tprhm_be has no current conformance binding pending an external composition and fresh direct target.

SIC: the prior worker suite included an equal-month annual work-bonus aggregate that is not stated in a public-policy document. Documentary employee-contribution and monthly work-bonus rules remain encoded, but tscee_be has no current conformance binding until the annual composition is kept outside Axiom and a fresh direct target is available.

SIC: documentary pensioner health/disability and solidarity contribution components remain encoded from the applicable laws and official withholding tables. The prior suite targeted a generated annual health-plus-solidarity aggregate that is not stated in a public-policy document, so tscpe_be has no current conformance binding pending external composition and a fresh direct target.
Minimum-wage definition (Type inc, switched off in BE_2025); a definitional input, not a benefit or tax the oracle pays out.

BEN: Covid-19 temporary-unemployment wage compensation for employees (RD 30.03.2020 family), Switch=on in BE_2025 and writing bwkmcee_s. Every compute branch is gated on bwkmceemy_s (months in the wage-compensation scheme): Elig_Cond (bwkmceemy_s > 0), both part/full-time BenCalc Comp_Cond branches (bwkmceemy_s>=1 & lhw<38, bwkmceemy_s>=1 & lhw>=38), and the final award bwkmcee_s = i_bwkmcee_s*bwkmceemy_s/12. bwkmceemy_s and lmcee_s are DefVar-initialised to 0; their only writer is policy TransLMA_be (Switch=off, comment "DO NOT SWITCH ON; ONLY WORKS WITH THE LMA ADD-ON"), which selects lay-off spells from lindi (sector) x dgn x i_mc_rand_* draws. None of {lmcee, lmcee_s, bwkmceemy, bwkmceemy_s, lindi, i_mc_rand_1, lma} exist in the BE_training_data schema (273 cols), so the worker template overlay drops any injected activator (the row is reindexed to the dataset header) and bwkmcee_s stays 0 for every synthetic case — the only achievable comparison is vacuous (0 == 0). Probe evidence (axiom-oracles#142, mirrors the bfapl #150/#158 lineage): 112-combination live sweep over {TransLMA_be off/on} x {6 activator-injection sets incl. all_activators} x {dgn 0/1} x {lhw 20/40} x {employee/self-employed} under BE_2025, real-config BE_2024_c1_2015_03_e2 over BE_training_data — 112/112 cells returned bwkmcee_s=0 (with internal bwkmceemy_s=lmcee_s=0 even when TransLMA_be is forced on and every activator column is injected, confirming the overlay drop). Lineage: docs/be-coverage-matrix.md.

BEN: Covid-19 wage compensation for the self-employed (droit passerelle / bridging right, Law 23.03.2020 family), Switch=on in BE_2025 and writing bwkmcse_s. Every eligibility and BenCalc branch is gated on lmcse_s (>=1) / bwkmcsemy_s (>0) — Elig_Cond loc=1 & bwkmcsemy_s>0 and loc!=1 & bwkmcsemy_s>0, the four income-tier Comp_Cond branches all lead with lmcse_s>=1, and the awards bwkmcse01_s/bwkmcse02_s = i_bwkmcse0*_s*bwkmcsemy_s/12. lmcse_s and bwkmcsemy_s are DefVar-initialised to 0; the sole writer is TransLMA_be (Switch=off, "DO NOT SWITCH ON; ONLY WORKS WITH THE LMA ADD-ON"), selecting from lindi x dgn x i_mc_rand_* draws. None of {lmcse, lmcse_s, bwkmcsemy, bwkmcsemy_s, lindi, i_mc_rand_1, lma} — nor even ysemy (self-employed months) — exist in the BE_training_data schema, so the overlay drops any injected activator and bwkmcse_s stays 0 for every synthetic case (vacuous 0 == 0). Probe evidence: the same 112-combination BE_2025 sweep (axiom-oracles#142) returned bwkmcse_s=0 in 112/112 cells, self-employed rows (yse>0, yem=0) included, with TransLMA_be forced on and every activator injected. Lineage: docs/be-coverage-matrix.md.
